**Finding: deviation (high)** — Rule ASSIGN.

- **Assignment clause (§15.6, p0814–p0819): compliant, at/above preferred.** Mutual; PB may assign without consent to an Affiliate or to a successor by merger, stock sale or asset sale (including reverse triangular mergers); and SFJ additionally may not assign to a pharma/biotech competitor without PB's sole-discretion consent. The Affiliate/successor guarantee mechanics (p0816) and the §7.5.3 encumbrance covenants are financing protections, not a consent gate on our assignment. §6.7.2's Change of Control Buy-Out is PB's option, so it benefits us and is not flagged.
- **§14.2.6 (p0765–p0766): fails the fallback / walk-away.** SFJ may terminate the entire Agreement in its sole discretion following a Change of Control of PB, with a 150%-of-Development-Costs payment — a vendor termination/re-pricing right on our change of control, which also hollows out the M&A carve-out we obtained in §15.6.

Redline (validated ok:true): deletes SFJ's change-of-control termination right and the associated 150% payment, retitles the section, and removes the now-orphaned consequence paragraph, while keeping PB's notice obligation intact.
